newsitem.title: USA: Westcoast declares force majeure at BC plant.
newsitem.headline: Westcoast declares force majeure at BC plant.

text.p: Westcoast Energy declared force majeure at its Fort Nelson natural gas processing plant in northeastern British Columbia, gas traders said Friday.
The plant processes about 750 million cubic feet of gas a day (mmcfd), the traders said.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
Following the news, spot prices at the AECO storage hub in Alberta rose to about C$1.64-1.65 per gigajoule from about C$1.57 earlier in the day.
Earlier Friday, spot prices at Sumas, Wash., were quoted lower around $1.20 per million British thermal units.
Traders said the effect may be minimal because force majeure was declared after nomination deadlines had lapsed.
The plant was shut June 10 for scheduled maintenance and was expected to return to service late this week.
Westcoast on Thursday reported the plant was ready to restart.
